column1: # ZAP scan rules configuration for Bookshelf API
# This is a JSON API (no HTML rendering). Rules that produce false positives for
# pure JSON APIs are set to IGNORE; critical injection/execution rules are FAIL.
# ── IGNORE: false positives for a JSON API ────────────────────────────────────

column3: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header — JSON API responses intentionally omit Cache-Control
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — source comments not present post-deploy
Charset Mismatch (Header Versus Meta Charset) — not applicable to JSON responses
Timestamp Disclosure — ISO timestamps in JSON responses are intentional

column1: # Headers set by SecurityHeadersMiddleware but absent on infrastructure-level responses
# (Cloudflare/Render 403s that never reach FastAPI). Suppressed to avoid false failures.

column3: X-Content-Type-Options — header is set by middleware; absent only on infra-served responses
Strict-Transport-Security — header is set by middleware in production; absent on infra-level 403s
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy — header is set by middleware; absent on infra-level responses

column1: # Structural false positive: proxy chain headers are inherent to the Cloudflare + Render setup

column3: Proxy Disclosure — reverse proxy chain (Cloudflare + Render) is intentional infrastructure

column1: # CSP rule 10055 fires because ZAP expects explicit per-directive overrides even when default-src
# covers all fetch directives. For a JSON API with default-src 'none' this is a false positive.

column3: CSP Failure to Define Directive with No Fallback — default-src 'none' intentionally covers all fetch directives

column1: # ── WARN: track but do not fail the build ─────────────────────────────────────

column3: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — API uses JWT Bearer tokens, not cookie-based sessions
Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — review after Cloudflare proxy is active
Weak Authentication Method — JWT Bearer is used; flag if ZAP misidentifies scheme
Application Error Disclosure — any detail in error bodies warrants review
Permissions Policy Header Not Set — header IS set by middleware; alert if ZAP reports absent

column1: # ── FAIL: hard failures — any finding blocks the pipeline ─────────────────────
